# Format Rollout Checklist: Unified Table Processing and Atomic Transaction Optimization

**Purpose**: Review whether the written requirements for a new row format, the compatibility floor, replica activation, safe writer disable, the separate secondary-index migration, and typed job startup are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-10-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are new row-format writes required to wait for a durable compatibility barrier covering every replica eligible to apply that format? [Completeness, Spec §FR-030, Spec §US7 scenario 1]
- [ ] CHK002 Are mixed formats, historical schemas, projected reads, full tombstones, restart, and safe writer disable required to be satisfied before new row-format writing begins? [Completeness, Spec §FR-030, Spec §US7 scenario 2]
- [ ] CHK003 Is a persisted format floor required so stored rows stay readable across restart and after writer activation is turned off? [Completeness, Spec §US7 scenario 2, Spec §FR-032, Data Model §1.10]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the row-format rollout and the stable-primary-key secondary-index redesign required to stay independently gated, with the index redesign also requiring a measured benefit and its own catch-up and publication validation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-031, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK005 Are existing data, table identity, ownership placement, version domains, and public contracts required to stay compatible, including a ban on automatic destructive migration, silent repartitioning, and unsupported downgrade? [Completeness, Spec §FR-032]
- [ ] CHK006 Are ordinary job capabilities required to be typed and validated at initialization, with no runtime type guessing for ordinary access? [Completeness, Spec §FR-034, Spec §US7]
- [ ] CHK007 Are storage and transfer error descriptions required to stand without a dependency on the application execution layer? [Completeness, Spec §FR-033, Spec §US7 scenario 3]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is "replica eligible to apply" defined so a reader can tell which members count, including offline, partitioned, joining, and non-voting members? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §FR-030, Spec §US7 scenario 1]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "durable cluster-wide compatibility" defined as one persisted floor rather than a per-node writer flag, and does that floor name the same set as "eligible replicas"? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §US7 scenario 1, Spec §FR-030, Data Model §1.10]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the row-format floor distinguished from schema history and from MVCC row-version history? [Clarity, Spec §FR-030, Spec §US7 scenario 2, Data Model §1.10]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "safe writer disable" specified as leaving rows already written readable and keeping the persisted floor, rather than rewriting or deleting stored data? [Clarity, Spec §US7 scenario 2, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "measured benefit" for the secondary-index redesign quantified with a metric and a decision threshold? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §FR-031]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the newer row format identified, including the current floor and the next floor, so Row V2 is distinct from the secondary-index migration? [Clarity, Spec §FR-030, Spec §FR-031, Data Model §1.10]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK014 Do User Story 7 scenario 1, FR-030, and the format-floor model agree that writer enablement waits until every eligible reader can read the newer format? [Consistency, Spec §US7 scenario 1, Spec §FR-030, Data Model §1.10]
- [ ] CHK015 Do FR-031, SC-011, and the assumptions agree that row-format activation and the stable-primary-key redesign are separate decisions and are not bundled with transaction batching? [Consistency, Spec §FR-031, Spec §SC-011, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK016 Does the task instruction to leave the secondary-index redesign unimplemented in this change agree with the spec treating that redesign as a gated follow-up? [Consistency, Spec §FR-031, Spec Assumptions, tasks.md T056]
- [ ] CHK017 Does FR-032's ban on unsupported downgrade agree with User Story 7 scenario 2, which requires mixed formats and historical schemas to stay readable when the writer is off? [Consistency, Spec §FR-032, Spec §US7 scenario 2]
- [ ] CHK018 Does FR-034's requirement for validated initialization agree with the task outcome that startup fails closed when the typed job capability is missing? [Consistency, Spec §FR-034, tasks.md User Story 7]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK019 Can SC-011 be decided as zero unreadable rows and zero lost deletes for mixed-format restart, failover, rebuild, and eligible-replica cases? [Measurability, Spec §SC-011]
- [ ] CHK020 Can "every incompatible-replica activation is rejected" be decided from a defined eligibility set and a defined incompatibility signal? [Measurability, Gap, Spec §SC-011, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK021 Are projected reads, full tombstones, historical schemas, restart, and writer disable given pass/fail outcomes, rather than only named as checks that must occur? [Measurability, Spec §FR-030, Spec §SC-011]
- [ ] CHK022 Is independent control of the row migration and the index migration observable as two gates that can be refused separately? [Measurability, Spec §SC-011, Spec §FR-031]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Are the primary activation flow, the refusal flow, and the writer-disable flow all specified? [Coverage, Spec §US7 scenarios 1 and 2]
- [ ] CHK024 Are recovery requirements specified for an interrupted activation, an interrupted index rebuild, and an incompatible replica that joins during activation? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases, Spec §SC-011]
- [ ] CHK025 Is reader behavior specified for mixed generations and for a reader older than the persisted floor? [Coverage, Gap, Spec Edge Cases, Spec §FR-032]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements defined when an eligible replica is offline or partitioned at the moment activation is requested? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-030, Spec §US7 scenario 1]
- [ ] CHK027 Are requirements defined for moving the format floor backward, including rows already written at a higher floor? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-032, Spec §US7 scenario 2]
- [ ] CHK028 Are requirements defined for deletes and tombstones written under the older format when the newer writer is enabled and later disabled? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-030, Spec §SC-011]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK029 Does the assumption that format rollout comes after proven atomic commit, and that a correctness defect blocks that rollout, match FR-030? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK030 Are stream tables and persisted system tables included in or excluded from the new row-format writer? [Dependency, Gap, Spec §FR-030, Spec §FR-041]
- [ ] CHK031 Is on-disk compatibility of existing user and shared key and value layouts required to hold until a gated format migration is actually activated? [Assumption, Spec §FR-032, Plan constraints]

## Ambiguities and Conflicts

- [ ] CHK032 Do "cluster-wide" in User Story 7 and "replicas eligible to apply it" in FR-030 name the same set? [Ambiguity, Spec §US7 scenario 1, Spec §FR-030, Data Model §1.10]
- [ ] CHK033 Does the floor model, which becomes true after eligible nodes report a sufficient reader, agree with the spec's durable barrier, or can a reported-but-not-yet-durable reader enable writing? [Conflict, Spec §FR-030, Data Model §1.10]
- [ ] CHK034 Does the plan's writer gate, which turns writing on from eligible-replica compatibility, require that decision to stay durable across restart and failover, as FR-030 and User Story 7 scenario 1 require? [Conflict, Spec §FR-030, Spec §US7 scenario 1, Plan Phase G, Data Model §1.10]

## Notes

- Scope is User Story 7: row-format rollout, replica compatibility, safe writer disable, the separate secondary-index migration, and typed job initialization. Catalog projections, unified storage design, and transaction-result rules stay in their own checklists.
- Depth is a standard review. Audience is the spec author before implementation.
- Items are unchecked. A check is recorded only when a reviewer decides the requirement text answers the question. A check does not mean implementation is complete (Spec §SC-012).
- CHK034 was appended beside CHK033. CHK033 compares the spec's durable barrier with a floor that becomes true when readers report readiness. CHK034 asks whether the plan's writer gate also requires that decision to survive restart and failover. It remains unchecked.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
